title: The private name list of conventions pre-push
description: The names of private projects that no public repository has. The file stays outside of the public repositories. The function parsePrivateNames of @mark1russell7/conventions checks the same fields.

$comment.description: A note for persons. The check does not read it.

names.description: The private names. A break names a name by its index from 1, for example name 3 of the private name list.

allow.description: The hits that a person examined and permitted, by repository and path.

id.description: The short name of the entry. Each id is different. An entry of allow refers to it. The check does not show it.

project.description: The private project of the name, as a note for persons. The check does not read it.

seeds.description: The fixed texts of the name, with case. A line with no seed of the list is no hit, so each text that a pattern or the word finds contains a seed.

patterns.description: The regular expressions of the name, in the syntax of JavaScript, with no flags. A match in a line or in a path of a file is a hit.

word.description: A word that is also a common word. A match of the whole word in a line is a hit only in a sentence that names the project, not in code, in a title or before a noun.

commonAfter.description: The lower-case words that make the word a common word when they come next. It needs the field word.

repo.description: The name of the repository, or owner/name. Case is not significant.

path.description: The path of the file from the root of the repository, with /. Case is significant.

name.description: The id of the permitted name. With no id, each name of the list is permitted in the file.
